description: This file defines a base test case class for the OrangeHRM project, extending PHPUnit's TestCase. It provides utility methods for testing, such as invoking private and protected methods, and accessing entity references via Doctrine ORM. The file is part of the test suite and enhances test capabilities for the OrangeHRM codebase.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: An abstract base class for unit testing in the OrangeHRM project, providing utility methods to facilitate testing of internal and private class members, and entity references.

methods.name: getEntityReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to a given entity by name and ID using the entity manager.

methods.name: getClassMethod
methods.description: Retrieves a ReflectionMethod object for a specified class method and makes it accessible for invocation.

methods.name: invokePrivateMethod
methods.description: Invokes a private method of a specified class with given parameters.

methods.name: invokePrivateMethodOnMock
methods.description: Invokes a private method on a mock object of a specified class.

methods.name: invokeProtectedMethod
methods.description: Invokes a protected method of a specified class with given parameters.

methods.name: invokeProtectedMethodOnMock
methods.description: Invokes a protected method on a mock object of a specified class.
